text:
morgan: quick heads-up: noticed ~3% 503s for short embeddings (<32 tokens) in eu-west1 starting ~02:10 UTC. p99 errors up. Suspect quant kernel regression from yesterday. Preparing hotfix revert to redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2. Need fast approvals to deploy during maintenance window.

liam: customer impact?

morgan: limited to short-embed paths; a few support tickets, not all customers. No schema changes.

sara: any cache work required?

morgan: recommend draining prefix cache after deploy; no DB migrations.

morgan: deploy request: /deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix --strategy canary=5%:3m (skip-canary if quick consensus) --reason "short-embed 503 regression"

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6372133344 created. Approvals required: eng-leads (liam,sara) + ops-oncall (dave-ops). Preflight: integration-tests PASS, smoke: WARNING (503 observed).

dave-ops: oncall here. I can approve ops if we do 5% canary for 3m, watch metrics, then ramp. I'll monitor traces.

liam: approve for eng if dave watches. /approve 6372133344

sara: approve for docs/QA. I'll prep a support blurb. /approve 6372133344

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: liam, sara, dave-ops. Starting canary 5%: embeddings-eu -> redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Canary window 180s. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6372133344

morgan: running drain then image set: kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix -n prod-eu

deploy-bot: Canary in progress. Initial metrics: new pod errors 0, latency stable.

dave-ops: canary looks good. ramp to 25% for 4m then full if stable.

deploy-bot: 25% ramp started. Window 240s.

deploy-bot: 25% complete, errors <0.1%, p95 +3ms. Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. Healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS.

morgan: drained prefix cache and warmed; no regressions in 10m post-deploy.

liam: please add release note: "Embeddings: hotfix revert to v2.3.2 to address 503s on short embeddings in eu-west1; canary ramp and prefix cache drain performed."

sara: filing support blurb.

morgan: will follow up with RCA on the quant kernel. Closing when notes posted. :white_check_mark:
